name: Crisp Spicy Tofu with Honeyed Cucumbers, Peaches, Almonds & Yogurt
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop almonds.
Once the skillet is hot, add the almonds; cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, place oil and spices in another medium bowl. Stir to combine the spice oil.
Medium dice tofu, add to the bowl with the spice oil, and gently stir to coat. Wipe the baking sheet dry with paper towels, then coat with a thin layer of oil; set aside.
Sprinkle bread crumbs over the tofu and stir once more to coat. Return tofu to the baking sheet and spread out in a single layer. (Wipe bowl clean with paper towels and reserve for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until tofu is golden brown and crispy, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice one lemon into the reserved bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Pick parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems. Mince half of the leaves and add to the bowl with the lemon. Roughly chop remaining leaves and set aside for serving.
Add yogurt and salt to the bowl, then whisk to combine the lemony yogurt. Set aside.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl with the almonds.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice the flesh and add to the bowl. Season the salad with salt, then stir to combine.
Divide tofu and lemony yogurt between plates. Top yogurt with the salad and reserved parsley, then drizzle with honey. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing and enjoy!
author: Mealime
